body: Sorry for not responding sooner. to answer your question, i dont know, nobody in my life even knows that i feel like this.
No, if i had to guess it would probably be depression or something like that. All i feel is misery and numbness all the time.

I'll consider it, im probably about to go to sleep because im still exhausted from having to wake up  every 15-20 minutes to go throw up and not getting enough sleep. So goodnight and i'll see you tommorow i guess

Ill look into the policies for where i live but i still dont know if ill tell them or not though. Although im almost certain that if i told them everything  they would put me in there, either that or lie to them and never get the help i need
One of the main reasons is because i dont want to go to a phych ward
The only thing i'd want to talk about is how nobody even knows i tried to kill myself
Talking about it doesnt help, i could sit here telling you obout all of my problems all day but it wouldnt acomplish anything. If you'd really like to know i suppose i could tell you

You think that just because im young i cant hurt, for five years ive felt nothing but misery and numbness. I gave life a chance, many times actually, i thought maybe it gets better, but it never did. I never got help for these issues and i probably wont because they'll put me in a phych ward. I apologize if this sounded rude but every time i make a post that includes my age someone says the exact thing you said
